chunks: 4235 - And Mūsā ibn Bakr al-Wāsiṭī narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, who said: I heard him saying:

Meat grows flesh, and fish melts the body. Gourd increases the brain, and frequent eating of eggs increases offspring. No sick person has sought healing with anything like honey, and whoever puts into his belly a morsel of fat, it brings out the like of it from illness.

key_terms.الدَّاءِ: illness; the ailment said to be driven out
key_terms.الدُّبَّاءُ: gourd; described as increasing the brain
key_terms.السَّمَكُ: fish; described as reducing or melting the body
key_terms.اللَّحْمُ: meat; described as nourishing and building flesh
key_terms.الْبَيْضِ: eggs; mentioned in connection with increase in offspring
key_terms.الْعَسَلِ: honey; described as an unmatched means of healing for the sick
key_terms.شَحْمٍ: fat; a morsel of it is said to expel illness

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام say about the health benefits of meat, fish, gourd, eggs, honey, and fat?
ai.summary: This hadith reports dietary benefits associated with several foods, presenting them as sources of bodily nourishment, healing, and increase in offspring. It reflects transmitted guidance on health and consumption attributed to Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4235 - Musa ibn Bakr al-Wasiti narrated from Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) that he said:

"Meat nourishes the flesh, and fish melts the body. Gourd increases intelligence, and eating eggs frequently increases offspring. No sick person has sought healing with anything better than honey. And whoever consumes a morsel of fat expels an equal amount of illness from his body."
